completion_promises.criterion_text: WebM with Duration element → correct seconds; Chrome-style streamed WebM (no Duration) → None
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented _probe_webm_duration() with EBML parsing that correctly reads TimestampScale and Duration elements, calculates seconds as (duration_ticks * timescale_ns) / 1_000_000_000. Handles streamed segments with unknown size marker (returns None). Validated by tests: test_webm_with_duration_element (5.0s), test_webm_streamed_returns_none, test_webm_with_custom_timescale (20.0s).

completion_promises.criterion_text: Ogg/Opus EOS granule → granule/48000; header-page granule 0 → None; false-sync OggS bytes skipped
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented _probe_ogg_duration() with backwards OggS scan that validates page structure, reads signed 64-bit LE granule position, checks EOS flag, and returns granule/48000. Returns None for header pages (granule 0). Backward scan naturally skips false-sync OggS bytes in packet data. Validated by tests: test_ogg_opus_eos_granule (3.5s), test_ogg_header_page_granule_zero, test_ogg_false_sync_skipped (2.0s with embedded fake OggS).

completion_promises.criterion_text: Unknown/absent content types and truncated/garbage bytes → None, never an exception
completion_promises.evidence: probe_duration_seconds() dispatches on lowercased base MIME (strips ;codecs), returns None for unknown types (audio/mp4, audio/mpeg, empty string). All parsing wrapped in try-except that returns None on any exception. Validated by tests: test_unknown_content_type_returns_none (4 unknown types), test_truncated_webm_returns_none (20-byte truncation), test_garbage_bytes_returns_none (binary garbage), test_truncated_ogg_returns_none (15-byte truncation), test_empty_content_returns_none.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Builders produce bytes the probe itself parses (round-trip tests)
completion_promises.evidence: Created make_webm(), make_ogg_page(), and make_ogg_opus() builders inline in test file (staying within 2-file minimal constraint). make_webm() generates valid EBML structure with EBMLVersion, DocType, Segment, Info, TimestampScale, and Duration elements. make_ogg_opus() generates valid 3-page Ogg/Opus file (OpusHead BOS, OpusTags, EOS with granule). Round-trip tests validate: test_builders_round_trip_webm (2.5s, 10.0s, 0.5s), test_builders_round_trip_ogg (1.0s, 2.5s, 5.0s, 10.5s) all pass with <0.01s tolerance.
